[/s][b] [color=#f4cccc][size=3]♡ [/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Fruit Rugs[/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]![/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=3] ♡[/size][/color][/b]

This is an Alternative Texture pack of rugs I created that can be applied to the vanilla "Light Green Rug" in game.

Once you have the this mod and the mod Alternative Textures installed you can purchase the "paint" tools from Robin's shop to change the texture of the rug using the paint bucket.

I [i]HIGHLY[/i] recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14092]Furniture Placement Tweaks[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10213]Furniture Adjustment [/url]﻿to get the most out of any furniture mod.
Furniture Placement Tweaks allows you to overlap furniture (among other features), and Furniture Adjustment allows you to move your furniture pixel by pixel to soothe your OCD.
